Neat! I want something like this I can:

-pass in real terrain from google earth + deformation
-drop/iterate on the model in UE5 with RT + VR (depth perception is critical for evaluating the feel of spaces)
-simulate different times of year with real sun position, lets me get the rotation of the house right for the various seasons and catch issues before building 

This looks amazing though
